blocks.text: Choosing the right school is a big decision. We've made the admissions process clear, personal, and straightforward so you can focus on finding the best fit for your child.

items.title: SCHEDULE A TOUR
items.text: Join us on a Tuesday at 9:00 AM to experience Kingdom Heights in action. Meet our team, explore our campus, and discover what makes our approach to Christian education different.

items.title: APPLY ONLINE
items.text: Complete our online application and submit the required documents. Our admissions team will guide you through each step of the process.

items.title: STUDENT ASSESSMENT
items.text: Students participate in an age-appropriate assessment to help us understand their academic readiness and identify how we can best support their growth.

items.title: FAMILY INTERVIEW
items.text: We believe education is a partnership. During the family interview, you will meet with school leaders to discuss your goals, ask questions, and ensure Kingdom Heights is the right fit for your family.

blocks.text: You are not doing this alone.
Our admissions team is here to help answer questions, navigate tuition options, explain the CHOOSE Act, and guide your family through every step of the process.
We offer discounts for Active Military Families, Paid-in-Full year payments, and Multi-Student Families.

blocks.title: Tuition calculator
blocks.text: Estimate annual tuition, standard fees, discounts, extended care, scholarship offsets, and common payment plan schedules for one student or a whole family.

items.title: Boldy Christian
items.text: We are committed to fostering a deep understanding of Scripture, believing that the Bible offers wisdom for every aspect of life and work. Biblical literacy forms the foundation of our understanding of the Holy Spirit, whom we believe nurtures and empowers our students for a lifelong commitment to service and ministry. We aim to create an environment where the Holy Spirit empowers our students to positively impact their communities and beyond, carrying the Kingdom of God into the world. With a rich history of shaping ethical and impactful leaders, biblical literacy helps cultivate individuals who strengthen societies. We are dedicated to partnering with parents to equip young people through the teaching of Scripture, empowering them with the confidence and compassion to fulfill their God-given purpose.

items.title: Advanced Academics
items.text: We take pride in our rigorous academic standards, ensuring that our graduates are exceptionally prepared for success. In a city renowned for its leadership in cybersecurity, technology, space exploration, and innovation, our mission is to equip students with the skills and knowledge needed to lead in these critical fields. We strive to inspire our students to pursue their ambitions—academic and beyond—and to become leaders who drive the continued growth and success of Huntsville's intelligence community.

items.title: Creative and Experiential
items.text: Huntsville is a unique community celebrated for its cutting-edge approach to globally significant fields like science and technology. At Kingdom Heights, we want to equip our graduates to flourish and excel in the new and innovative challenges of our city. We are committed to fostering creativity and hands-on learning. Our approach includes dedicated tracks for creative arts and entrepreneurship/redemptive enterprise, empowering students to explore and develop their talents. By encouraging innovative thinking and practical experience, we aim to equip our students to push progress forward and make meaningful contributions to society.

items.title: Career Focused
items.text: We will provide our high school students with numerous opportunities for job placements, internships, and hands-on learning in high-impact fields such as space exploration, cybersecurity, technology and innovation, engineering, and national defense. Our graduates will have the chance to build dynamic resumes, enhance both their soft and hard skills, and establish valuable networks, paving the way for early entry into their chosen fields.

blocks.text: Partnering with families every step of the way

Thank you for your interest in Kingdom Heights Preparatory School. We are excited about what God is doing on our campus through our students, faculty and staff, and families. Choosing the right school for your child is one of the most important decisions you will ever make. It is during these formative years that life-long friendships are made, spiritual formation takes place, and values will be instilled. Kingdom Heights Preparatory School looks forward to partnering with you in your child’s education. If you have any questions, please reach us at admissions@khroyals.com .
A Private Education for Huntsville and Madison AL, families is more affordable than ever.

The Alabama CHOOSE Act empowers families to make the best educational choice for their children by providing up to $7,000 in annual tuition support for qualifying students. Kingdom Heights Preparatory School is proud to be a CHOOSE Act-approved school , making Christ-centered, academically excellent education more accessible than ever. This historic opportunity allows families to invest in their child’s future without burdensome financial barriers. Apply now to see if your family qualifies and take the next step toward a Kingdom Heights education!
